answer_2.quote: We employ accuracy to quantify performance on NLI tasks and introduce new metrics to assess the explanatory power of LLMs. Semantic Fidelity Score (SFS) evaluates the extent to which the generated content preserves the essential meaning of the source text... Internal Consistency Score (ICS) assesses whether there are logical contradictions within the reasoning steps... Explanation Quality Score (EQS) integrates the SFS and ICS to reflect the overall quality of LLMs' output... Confidence Score (CFS) is designed to evaluate LLMs' self-assessment capabilities.
